subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the given set of classes.

Polygons, Quadrilaterals and Triangles
solution:
• The relationship between Polygons, Quadrilaterals and Triangles is as follows:

i) All triangles are polygon

ii) All quadrilaterals are polygon

iii) No Quadrilateral is triangle.

 
• Here, the possible Venn diagram will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60b75a94ae1daacfdd50e73d75ee8207e75cdc0b95f0b1251d7baae37dcf8499.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is the figure given in option 2.
